Table 20: Forward evaluation of the frozen production snapshots on GAS-Station weeks generated after their training cutoff (fake recall at the fixed 0.5 threshold; the stream contains only synthetic media). W28 is partial (through July 8, 2026).

Figure 1: The SN34 loop. Generative miners, validators, and discriminative miners interact through Subnet 34: verified minergenerated media are versioned in the GAS-Station data plane, and detector submissions are scored by the s34 objective in gasbench runs over GAS-Station data, public benchmarks, and a private holdout. Each round’s winning basis seeds the production export (BMF), which we fine-tune and extend before it serves the organics detection API (§3.1).
